source.authors: Minbo Gao; Zhengfeng Ji; Chenghua Liu
source.title: Lévy-Khintchine Structure Enables Fast-Forwardable Lindbladian Simulation

families.scope: paper-defined Gaussian dephasing family; constants and error dependence must be sourced from full theorem
paper-defined compound-Poisson family; constants and error dependence must be sourced from full theorem
paper-defined symmetric stable family; constants and error dependence must be sourced from full theorem

acceptance_gates: source-exact theorem assumptions are written down before implementation
independent channel and twirling implementations agree within the frozen tolerance on bounded fixtures
held-out time/parameter points are reported with raw data and uncertainty
negative controls and numerical-tolerance sensitivity are retained
the same output, accuracy, and resource-accounting contract is used for classical and quantum routes
any scaling fit is labelled MODEL_ONLY and is not treated as proof of the theorem
independent reproduction is required before algorithmic promotion
